title: Airy Flaky Norwegian Lamb Puff
description: A yeasty and tender Norwegian dish featuring lamb mince and lamination puff, perfect for a solo dinner, and ovo-vegetarian friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
Combine the flour, yeast, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add the cold butter to the flour mixture and use a pastry blender to work it into a crumbly mixture.
Gradually add the milk to the mixture, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
Roll the dough out into a large rectangle, about 1/2 cm thick.
Spread the lamb mince evenly over the center of the dough, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the lamb mince, pressing gently to seal.
Place the puff on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, brush with beaten egg, and cut a few slits in the top.
Bake the puff in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the puff from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
